sn51.10:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2.
sn51.10:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi ||
sn51.10:1.4: Vesāliyam piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantam Ānandam āmantesi ||
sn51.10:1.7: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanam ādāya Bhagavantam piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi || || 3.
sn51.10:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena Cāpālacetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || ||
sn51.10:2.2: Āyasmā pi kho Ānando Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 4.
sn51.10:2.3: Ekam antam nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Ānandam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn51.10:3.1: Ramaṇiyā Ānanda Vesālī ramaṇiyam Udenacetiyam ramaṇiyaṃ Gotamakacetiyaṃ ramaṇiyaṃ Sattambacetiyaṃ ramaṇiyam Bahuputtakacetiyaṃ ramaṇiyaṃ Sārandadam cetiyaṃ ramaṇiyaṃ Cāpālacetiyaṃ || ||
sn51.10:3.2: Yassa kassaci Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā || so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā || ||
sn51.10:3.3: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā || ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda Tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā ti || || 5.
sn51.10:4.1: Evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ ||
sn51.10:4.3: Tiṭṭhatu bhante Bhagavā kappam tiṭṭhatu Sugato kappāvasesaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan ti || yathā tam Mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto || || 6--7.
sn51.10:5.2: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Ānandam āmantesi ||
sn51.10:5.3: Ramaṇiyā Ānanda Vesālī ramaṇiyam Udeṇacetiyaṃ ramaṇiyaṃ Gotamakacetiyam ramaṇiyaṃ Sattambacetiyaṃ ramaṇiyam Bahuputtakacetiyaṃ ramaniyaṃ Sārandadam cetiyam ramaṇiyaṃ Cāpālacetiyaṃ || ||
sn51.10:5.4: Yassa kassaci Ānanda cattāro iddhipadā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā || so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā ||
sn51.10:5.5: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā || so ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda Tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā ti || || 9.
sn51.10:6.1: Evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ ||
sn51.10:6.3: Tiṭṭhatu Bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu Sugato kappāvasesaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokanukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan ti || yathā tam Mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto || || 10.
sn51.10:7.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Ānandam āmantesi ||
sn51.10:7.3: yassa dāni tvaṃ kālam maññasī ti || ||
sn51.10:7.4: Evam bhante ti āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi || || 11.
sn51.10:8.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā acīrapakkante āyasmante Ānande yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca ||
sn51.10:9.1: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu dāni Sugato parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato || ||
sn51.10:9.2: Bhāsitā kho panesā bhante Bhagavatā vācā ||
sn51.10:9.3: na tāvāham Pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakam ācariyakam uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttanīkarissanti || uppannam parappavādam sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammam desissantī ti || ||
sn51.10:10.1: Santi kho pana bhante etarahi bhikkhū Bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakam ācariyakam uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññāpenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti || uppannam parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti || || 12.
sn51.10:10.2: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu dāni Sugato parinibbanakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato || ||
sn51.10:11.1: Bhāsitā kho panesā bhante Bhagavatā vācā ||
sn51.10:11.2: Na tāvāham Pāpima parinibbāyissami yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti ||
sn51.10:13.3: Yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti || yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo || sakam ācariyakam uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannam parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītam niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī ti || ||
sn51.10:14.1: Santi kho pana bhante etarahi upāsakā ||
sn51.10:14.2: upāsikā Bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā vīsāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakam ācariyakam uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññāpenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti || uppannam parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti || || 14.
sn51.10:14.3: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu dāni Sugato || parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato || ||
sn51.10:15.2: Na tāvāham Pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me idam brahmacariyam na iddhaṃ ceva bhavissati || phītaṃ ca vitthāritaṃ bāhujāññaṃ puthubhutaṃ yāvad eva manussehi supakāsitan ti || ||
sn51.10:15.3: Tayidam bhante Bhagavato brahmacariyam iddham ceva phitañca vitthāritam bahujaññam puthubhūtam yāvad eva manussehi supakāsitaṃ || ||
sn51.10:15.4: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu dāni Sugato parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato ti || || 15.
sn51.10:16.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Māram pāpimantam etad avoca || ||
sn51.10:16.2: Apossukko tvam Pāpima hohi || na ciraṃ Tathāgatassa parinibbānam bhavissati ||
sn51.10:16.3: ito tiṇṇam māsānam accayena Tathāgato parinibbāyissatī ti || || 16.
sn51.10:17.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāram ossaji || ||
sn51.10:17.2: Ossaṭṭhe pana Bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako lomahaṃso || devadundubhiyo ca caliṃsu || || 17.
sn51.10:17.3: Atha kho Bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyam imam udānam udānesi || ||
